ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the two medians $AD$ and $BE$ of $\triangle ABC$ intersect at point $F$. Connecting $CF$, if the area of $\triangle ABF$ is $8$, what is the area of $\triangle ABC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that the two medians $AD$ and $BE$ of $\triangle ABC$ intersect at point $F$,\\
$\therefore 2EF=BF$,\\
$\because$ the area of $\triangle ABF$ is $8$,\\
$\therefore$ the area of $\triangle AEF$ is $4$,\\
$\therefore$ the area of $\triangle ABE$ is $12$.\\
$\because AE$ is the median of $\triangle ABC$,\\
$\therefore$ the area of $\triangle ABC$ is $2$ times the area of $\triangle ABE$ which equals $\boxed{24}$.
